night_owl_student.description: Small steps work in the morning, deadlines at night. Halfway through, deadlines stop working (exams are over).

people_pleaser.description: Moves when someone is in it with them. Rewards help in the evening.

maya.description: Maya (the demo profile): tiny steps and working alongside her in the morning, deadlines in the evening. Streaks and praise do nothing.

overwhelmed_student.description: Pressure backfires. Tiny, concrete first moves and company work.
